title: The Final Cipher
author: Vesper Joubert
blurb: Odile Voss, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
